# pve_cpu_flags (Data Source)

QEMU cluster info and available CPU flags for custom CPU models.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_cpu_flags" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `accel` (String) Acceleration type to check node compatibility for. (default: kvm) One of: `kvm`, `tcg`.
- `arch` (String) Virtual processor architecture. Defaults to the host architecture. One of: `x86_64`, `aarch64`.

### Read-Only

- `flags` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/qemu/cpu-flags. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--flags))
- `id` (String) Identifier: .
- `qemu` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /cluster/qemu (the API schema does not describe its shape).

<a id="nestedatt--flags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `flags`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the CPU flag.
- `name` (String) Name of the CPU flag.
- `supported_on` (List of String) List of nodes supporting the flag with the selected acceleration type ("accel").
